title: Detailed banana
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bananaBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE87A'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFD23F'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8A81C'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bananaShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F2B72E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C98A12'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bananaRidge' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFEF9E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD95E'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow-side curve of the banana body -->
  <path d='M20 30 C 15 55, 30 80, 62 84 C 82 86, 90 74, 88 62 C 86 52, 78 48, 72 52 C 66 56, 64 62, 68 66 C 70 69, 74 68, 75 65 C 76 61, 72 59, 69 60 C 60 66, 50 64, 44 56 C 38 48, 36 36, 30 30 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaShade)'/>

  <!-- main bright body -->
  <path d='M22 28 C 18 56, 32 78, 62 82 C 80 84, 87 72, 85 61 C 84 53, 77 49, 72 52 C 66 55, 64 62, 68 66 C 70 68, 73 67, 74 64 C 75 61, 72 59, 69 60 C 60 65, 51 63, 45 55 C 39 47, 37 35, 32 28 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaBody)'/>

  <!-- highlight ridge down the middle -->
  <path d='M30 32 C 28 52, 38 68, 58 74 C 50 70, 42 58, 40 44 C 39 38, 36 33, 30 32 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaRidge)' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- second subtle ridge line -->
  <path d='M26 34 C 25 50, 33 66, 50 74'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- facet edge line -->
  <path d='M45 55 C 51 63, 60 65, 69 60'
        fill='none' stroke='#D89A18' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- brown speckles -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='47' rx='1.4' ry='1' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='60' rx='1.6' ry='1.1' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='1.4' ry='1' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='74' rx='1.3' ry='0.9' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='40' rx='1.1' ry='0.8' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='63' rx='1.2' ry='0.9' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.65'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='64' rx='1' ry='0.7' fill='#9A6B12' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- stem at top -->
  <path d='M27 27 C 26 22, 26 18, 24 14 C 23 12, 25 11, 27 12 C 29 14, 29 19, 30 24 Z'
        fill='#7A8C2E'/>
  <path d='M27 26 C 27 21, 27 17, 26 14' fill='none' stroke='#9AB040' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tip at bottom right -->
  <path d='M84 62 C 88 64, 91 66, 92 69 C 92 71, 90 71, 89 70 C 87 67, 85 65, 83 63 Z'
        fill='#6E5A1E'/>
  <path d='M85 63 C 88 65, 90 67, 91 69' fill='none' stroke='#A88A3A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
